Name: Brown Planthopper (BPH)
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Imidacloprid (0.4 ml/L of water) [17.8% a.i.]
Thiamethoxam (0.4 g/L of water) [25% a.i.]
Dinotefuran (0.2 g/L of water) [20% a.i.]
Buprofezin (1.25 ml/L of water) [25% a.i.]

Name: Rice Stem Borer
Symptoms: Dead hearts in young plants, whiteheads in mature plants.
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Chlorantraniliprole (0.4 ml/L of water) [18.5% a.i.]
Flubendiamide (0.1 g/L of water) [20% a.i.]
Fipronil (2 ml/L of water) [5% a.i.]
Cartap Hydrochloride (1 g/L of water) [50% a.i.]

Name: Leaf Folder
Symptoms: Leaves folded and webbed together, feeding on leaf tissue.
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Chlorantraniliprole (0.4 ml/L of water) [18.5% a.i.]
Flubendiamide (0.1 g/L of water) [20% a.i.]
Lambda-cyhalothrin 5 ec  (0.5 ml/L of water) [5% a.i.]
Spinosad (0.25 ml/L of water) [45% a.i.]

Name: Green Leafhopper
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Imidacloprid (0.2 ml/L of water) [20% a.i.]
Thiamethoxam (0.2 g/L of water) [25% a.i.]
Acephate (1 g/L of water) [75% a.i.]

Name: Rice Hispa
Symptoms: Scraping of leaf surface, white streaks on leaves.
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Chlorpyrifos (2.5 ml/L of water) [20% a.i.]
Lambda-cyhalothrin (0.3 ml/L of water) [5% a.i.]

Name: Gall Midge
Symptoms: Formation of silvery white leaf galls (onion leaf).
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Fipronil (2 ml/L of water) [5% a.i.]
Imidacloprid (0.4 ml/L of water) [17.8% a.i.]

Name: Rice Blast
Symptoms: Diamond-shaped lesions on leaves, neck rot.
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Tricyclazole (0.6 g/L of water) [75% a.i.]
Isoprothiolane (1 ml/L of water) [40% a.i.]
Azoxystrobin (0.5 ml/L of water) [23% a.i.]
Hexaconazole (1 ml/L of water) [5% a.i.]

Name: Sheath Blight
Symptoms: Irregular, elliptical lesions on leaf sheath, wilting.
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Validamycin (2 g/L of water) [3% a.i.]
Propiconazole (1 ml/L of water) [25% a.i.]
Hexaconazole (1 ml/L of water) [5% a.i.]
Azoxystrobin (0.5 ml/L of water) [23% a.i.]

Name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB)
Symptoms: Yellowing and drying of leaf tips, bacterial ooze.
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Copper hydroxide (2 g/L of water) [77% a.i.]
Streptomycin sulphate + Tetracycline hydrochloride (200 ppm) [90% a.i. combined]
Plant activators like BTH (Benzothiadiazole) (0.1 g/L of water) [50% a.i.]

Name: False Smut
Symptoms: Greenish spore balls on grains, stunted growth.
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Carbendazim (1 g/L of water) [50% a.i.]
Propiconazole (1 ml/L of water) [25% a.i.]
Hexaconazole (1 ml/L of water) [5% a.i.]
Azoxystrobin (0.5 ml/L of water) [23% a.i.]

Name: Tungro Virus
Symptoms: Stunted growth, yellow to orange discoloration.
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Vector control with Imidacloprid (0.2 ml/L of water) [20% a.i.]
Thiamethoxam (0.2 g/L of water) [25% a.i.]

Name: Bakanae Disease
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Prochloraz (1 ml/L of water) [45% a.i.]
Carbendazim (1 g/L of water) [50% a.i.]
Thiophanate-methyl (1 g/L of water) [70% a.i.]

Name: Rice Sheath Rot
Symptoms: Rotting and discoloration of the leaf sheath.
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Carbendazim (1 g/L of water) [50% a.i.]
Thiophanate-methyl (1 g/L of water) [70% a.i.]

Name: Root Knot Nematode
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Carbofuran (apply at 1 kg a.i./ha) [3% a.i.]
Fipronil (0.3 ml/L of water) [5% a.i.]

Name: White Tip Nematode
Symptoms: White tips on leaves, twisting and curling.
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Carbofuran (apply at 1 kg a.i./ha) [3% a.i.]
Fenamiphos (2 kg a.i./ha) [10% a.i.]

Name: Rodents
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Zinc phosphide (bait application) [2% a.i.]
Bromadiolone (bait application) [0.005% a.i.]

Name: Weeds
Symptoms: Competition for nutrients, water, and light.
Recommended Agrochemicals:
Pre-emergence: Butachlor (1.5 kg a.i./ha) [50% a.i.]
Post-emergence: Bispyribac sodium (25 g a.i./ha) [10% a.i.]
